Hi Samira — Jordan here from Solutions. Quick answers before the call: 

- Minimum permissions: read-only for code, metadata, and Actions/workflow read; admin-level permissions are NOT required. We request 'workflows' and 'contents: read' in the GitHub App scope.
- Repo scoping: the app can be installed at org-level or limited to a selected subset of repos — you control that during install.
- Webhooks: we only need push and workflow_run events for CI observability; webhook payloads are encrypted in transit and we support verifying signatures.
- Token handling: tokens are rotated automatically; you never need to share a static token. We can also support org-wide SSO for larger customers.

I can cover these briefly at the start of the demo; Wed Nov 11 1:00 PM EST / 10:00 AM PST works for me. Looking forward to it — if you prefer a slightly longer slot (45m) to walk through an example repo and CI config, say the word.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
